theorems.statement: ∀ (M : ℕ) [NeZero M], ∃ B : InnerProductSpace.Core ℂ (CuspForm (CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 M) 2), ∀ (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hpM : ¬ p ∣ M) (f g : CuspForm (CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 M) 2), B.inner (CuspForm.heckeTLin 2 hp hpM f) g = B.inner f (CuspForm.heckeTLin 2 hp hpM g)
theorems.natural_summary: Combines accepted effective-domain, Petersson-integral-core, and Hecke-adjointness declarations to obtain one Core symmetric for every good prime.
